win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 19. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

wilds.name: The Toad & the Pot
wilds.behavior:
The Toad symbol is a revealing symbol that reveals either a Wild symbol or a Gold Coins symbol when activated by the Prosperity Pot symbol! All Toad symbols reveal the same type of symbol.

 When the Prosperity Pot symbol lands, it first shows what all Toad symbols will reveal and then transforms into the revealed symbol.

 Gold Coins scatter symbols are cash prizes based on your current bet. All Gold Coins symbols are added together and the total amount is multiplied by your current bet to produce the win amount.

 Gold Coins can have the following values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 50, 75, 100, 250, 500, 750, 1000

 When revealing Gold Coins symbols, there is a chance that a Toad symbol instead reveals a Coin Bag scatter symbol.

 Coin Bag symbols reveal a multiplier value, and then multiply 1 - 5 Gold Coins symbols with the revealed value. The same Gold Coins pile symbol can be affected multiple times by the same Coin Bag, or by different Coin Bags.

 Coin Bags can have the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5

wilds.name: GOLDEN TOAD BONUS
wilds.behavior:
Land 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to trigger this feature, which awards 10 free spins!

 The GOLDEN TOAD BONUS game has progressive Toad Points that do not reset after each Prosperity Pot activation! See description of TOAD BONUS above for other rules.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

scatters.name: TOAD BONUS
scatters.behavior:
Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to trigger this feature, which awards 10 free spins!

 Land Dragon and Double Dragon scatter symbols to collect Toad Points above the reels!

 Dragon symbols add 1 - 5 Toad Points to the meter above the reel where it landed.

 Double Dragon symbols add 1 - 5 Toad Points to all reels!

 When the Prosperity Pot symbol lands, an equal amount of Toad symbols will fill random positions on the corresponding reels.

 Toad Points are reset after each Prosperity Pot symbol has activated.

 Completely filling the Toads Points meter above all reels at the same time awards 10 additional free spins!

 Landing 3 FS symbols at the same time in the feature awards 4 additional free spins.

 Landing 4 FS symbols at the same time in the feature instantly triggers the GOLDEN TOAD BONUS. If the remaining number of free spins is less than 10, the remaining number of free spins will be set to 10. Otherwise, the current number of remaining free spins is unchanged.
